subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He is a smug and very ______ person who thinks only about himself.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**egoistic'** means someone who is excessively preoccupied with themselves and their own needs, often at the expense of others. (अहंकारी)

 
 
• **Example: **His **egoistic **behavior often alienated his friends and family.
 
• **Examples: **She is** **extremely **egoistic **and lack empathy for others.
 
 
 
• In the context of someone who thinks only about themselves, the most appropriate word is** 'egoistic'.**

Therefore, the correct statement is **He is a smug and very** ***egoistic*** **person who thinks only about himself.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arsonist **(आगजनी करने वाला): A person who deliberately sets fire to property.

 
 
• **Example:** The ***arsonist ***was caught on camera setting fire to the warehouse.
 
 
 
• **Diffident **(संकोची): Modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence.
 
 
• **Example: **She was ***diffident ***about her abilities, even though she was very talented.
 
 
 
• **Humble** (विनम्र): Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he remains a*** humble*** person.
